goal: Prevent peers and miners from exhausting node memory and CPU with specially crafted blocks and transactions
Reduce peak memory usage and deserialization time by storing witness stacks in their serialized wire format
reviewability: Ready to review the logic now, though a mechanical rebase against master is needed
agreement: Broad concept support for addressing deserialization memory exhaustion (furszy, 0xB10C, instagibbs, w0xlt, rkrux)
Verified by testing on Windows after resolving span allocation concerns (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: unknown witness versions still cause a 91 MiB allocation in script checks (fametrano)
Unaddressed objection: touches 76 files with an interim layout before data access is abstracted (purpleKarrot)
Suggests splitting the work into interface conversion, representation, and validation checks (alexanderwiederin)

why: P1 because it protects message processing from peer-induced memory exhaustion
